description: Client SDK for Construction Account Admin API
releaseNotes:
Breaking changes.
    • Page suffix added to models capable of pagination.
    • Removed Response Suffix from models.  
    • Changed the response of the importUsers from UserImportResponse to UserImport.
    • Changed the response of createBusinessUnits from BusinessUnitsResponse to BusinessUnits.
    • Changed the payload of createBusinessUnits from BusinessUnitsRequestPyload to BusinessUnitsPayload.
    • Changed the response of getBusinessUnits from BusinessUnitsResponse to BusinessUnits.
    • Changed the response of getProjectCompanies from CompanyResponse to ProjectCompanies.
    • Changed the response of importCompanies from CompanyImportResponse to CompanyImport.
    • Changed the response of createProjectImage from ProjectPatchResponse to ProjectPatch.
    • Changed the response of getProjects from Projects to ProjectsPage.
    • Changed the response of assignProjectUser from ProjectUserResponse to ProjectUserDetails.
    • Changed the response of getProjectUsers from ProjectUsers to ProjectUsersPage.
    • Changed the response of importProjectUsers from ProjectUsersImportResponse to ProjectUsersImport.
    • Changed the response of updateProjectUser from ProjectUserResponse to ProjectUserDetails.
    • Added New Models
      ◦ accountCompaniesPage
      ◦ accountCompany
      ◦ accountCompanyAddresses
      ◦ addressType
      ◦ companyOrFilters
      ◦ companyStatus
      ◦ filterCompanyFields
      ◦ filterCompanySort
    • Renamed Existing Models
      ◦ Renamed businessUnitsRequest to businessUnitsObject.
      ◦ Renamed businessUnitsRequestPyload to businessUnitsPayload.
      ◦ Renamed businessUnitsResponse to businessUnits.
      ◦ Renamed companyImportResponse to companyImport.
      ◦ Renamed companyResponse to projectCompanies.
      ◦ Renamed projectPatchResponse to projectPatch.
      ◦ Renamed projects to projectsPage.
      ◦ Renamed projectUserResponse to projectUserDetails.
      ◦ Renamed projectUsers to projectUsersPage.
      ◦ Renamed projectUsersImportResponse to projectUsersImport.
      ◦ Renamed userImportResponse to userImport.
    • Deleted Models
      ◦ projectsPagination
